_note: 5 Bhagavad Gita verses with gold metre, explicit pada boundaries and gold padaccheda. Reduced from the spec's 100 to hold the project near zero cost; every harness reads its row count from this file, so restoring the full set is a data change. All five verses are Anustubh — see _coverage.
_coverage: This set exercises Anustubh only. The other seven metres in the metre table are covered by unit tests against their gana patterns in tests/test_chandas.py, not by real-verse data. Stated plainly so no one reads a 5/5 score as evidence the whole table is validated.

verses.reference_translation: On the field of dharma, the field of the Kurus, gathered together, eager to fight.
You have a right to action alone, never to its fruits.
As the embodied soul passes in this body from childhood to youth to old age.

verses.devanagari: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत
verses.iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata
verses.reference_translation: Whenever there is a decline of dharma, O Bharata.
Let one lift oneself by oneself; let one not degrade oneself.
